mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent handle the design process for attached ADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent approaches the design process for attached ADUs collaboratively, starting with a consultation to understand your needs and the specific characteristics of your property. Our team works with you to create a design that maximizes space, ensures functionality, and adheres to local zoning regulations in your area, such as Oakland or Pleasanton. We aim to integrate the ADU aesthetically with your existing home while ensuring it meets all structural and safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent handles design collaboratively, starting with a consultation to understand needs and property specifics, creating a functional, compliant, and aesthetically integrated plan.
